datasets.name: Predĺženia zmlúv podľa mesiaca, kanála a tarify
datasets.description: Mesačné počty končiacich a predĺžených zmlúv a mesačný poplatok.
datasets.sql: SELECT mesiac, kanal AS "kanál", tarifa, region AS "región", koncace AS "končiace zmluvy", predlzenia AS "predĺženia", poplatok AS "mesačný poplatok", email_zakaznika FROM renewals WHERE (:from IS NULL OR mesiac >= :from) AND (:to IS NULL OR mesiac <= :to)

datasets.name: Predaj podľa kanála
datasets.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', sold_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS mesiac, channel AS kanal, product, sum(price)::numeric AS trzby, count(*) AS pocet FROM mart.sales WHERE (:from::text IS NULL OR sold_at >= to_date(:from, 'YYYY-MM')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
